criteria.text: The board canvas SHALL render ordered lists horizontally.
Cards SHALL render in rank order within each list.
Users with move permission SHALL be able to drag a card within the same list.
Users with move permission SHALL be able to drag a card to another list including an empty list.
The client SHALL provide optimistic visual feedback for card/list movement.
Failed move persistence SHALL roll the UI back or reconcile to authoritative server state.
Ordering SHALL use a scalable rank strategy such as fractional indexing or LexoRank-style values, not renumber every sibling on each move.
Move results SHALL persist after refresh.
Concurrent movement SHALL be resolved using version/revision checks and authoritative rank reconciliation.
Demonstrate the scoped authorized workflow and applicable denial, retry/lifecycle and UXA-01–08 checks; retain exact revision results and integrate with no known critical regression.
Record exact existing code/test paths and revision; execute the smallest relevant check or record why it is blocked; enumerate remaining behavior and one-cycle gap tasks without discarding history.
Reviewer can follow every scoped requirement to an existing result or an explicit unverified gap; no source-reference match is counted as a passing test.
